name: OWASP Top 10 (Web Application Security Risks)
description: OWASP's list of the ten most critical security risks to web applications, representing a broad consensus on where the greatest risk of harm lies for organizations building web software.
contentStatusNotice: Category identifiers and structure are drawn from the public OWASP Top 10:2025. Purpose, summary, and review guidance are application-authored to support compliance review workflows and are not official OWASP guidance.
